rungs.comment: PL-01 line. Each routine matches one cabinet drawing in the Panel tab: Safety + Line = MCP-1, Palletizer_R1 = RCP-1, MachineTending_R2 = RCP-2.
MCP-1: line E-stop ES1 (DI I0) and both motor overloads OL1/OL2 (DI I4) must be healthy.
Conveyor contactor M1 commanded but its aux contact (DI I3) never closes: jam / contactor fault after 2 s.
Any fault.
0.5 s flasher for the stack light.
Start (PB1 or HMI) / stop (PB2 is NC, or HMI) seal-in. Drops on any safety fault.
MCP-1 DO O0: contactor M1, case conveyors (MTR1). OpenCell runs the belts only while M1 aux (Conv_Running) is on.
MCP-1 DO O1: contactor M2, pallet lines, transfer and wrapper (MTR2).
Stack light green: running.
Stack light amber: stopped and healthy, or order complete.
Stack light red: flashes on any fault.
RCP-1 DO O0: servo contactor K1 for the R-2000iC palletizer. Needs the line running and the pendant E-stop + fence gate (DI I0). OpenCell holds PAL_MAIN while K1 aux (R1_Servo_On) is off.
K1 commanded but no feedback for 2 s.
RCP-1 DO O1: SERVO RUN lamp while PAL_MAIN runs.
RCP-1 DO O2: robot UI start / enable, wired to the robot input. The robot only runs its program while this input is on.
RCP-2 DO O0: servo contactor K1 for the M-20iA machine tender on its rail.
K1 commanded but no feedback for 2 s.
RCP-2 DO O1: SERVO RUN lamp while MTMAIN runs.
RCP-2 DO O2: robot UI start / enable, wired to the robot input. The robot only runs its program while this input is on.
New order from the HMI or PB3 RESET: OpenCell resets its order counters and the dispensers release pallets again.
Keep the order settings in range (the HMI and the line panel both write them).
